# brainTrade Work Log

## 2026-09-01 17:45 UTC — [Pillar 2] Broad two-hour loss block reinforces every Smart Entry veto

**Task:** Settle the pending and newest Smart Entry observations, retest performance by direction, hour, and edge threshold, and enforce the frozen 15 UTC NO challenger without changing its checkpoint.
**Finding:** Public-GET settlement appended 12 validated rows, expanding the immutable ledger from 5,622 to 5,634 unique markets at SHA-256 `d8b7361bf49bf1a886edea326e6500e749a18f1cc5dbbcbf24d28a333c58c332`; markets `4038618` and `4038627` remain pending. The permanent 289-second late observation stayed excluded before network I/O, and request-count and exclusion-count invariants passed. The new block was 2/12 with -64.34% mean, -82.00% leave-best-out, and -10.72% SolSt1ne. Failure was broad: YES was 1/7 at -71.71% mean, NO 1/5 at -54.02%, 16 UTC 1/5 at -54.02%, 17 UTC 1/7 at -71.71%, edge below 0.22 was 1/6 at -61.69%, and edge at or above 0.22 was 1/6 at -67.00%; every slice fell to -100% after removing its best result. The frozen 15 UTC NO cohort received no new qualifying row and remains 2/5 on one date with -19.19% mean, -49.49% leave-best-out, and -7.68% SolSt1ne; all boundary and uniqueness validations passed and the fixed 10-row rejection checkpoint remains untriggered.
**My thinking:** Losses spanning both directions, adjacent hours, and both sides of the edge threshold indicate a hostile broad regime rather than a narrow parameter defect. Carving a winner-derived exception from this block would be pure post-outcome selection. The 15 UTC NO challenger is also clearly weak, but rejecting at five rows would violate its preregistered minimum and contaminate the forward test.
**Decision:** Classify `P2_BROAD_16_17UTC_FAILURE_ALL_SLICES_NONROBUST_15UTC_NO_HOLDS_2_OF_5`. Preserve every existing veto and the frozen challenger definition, collect to the 10-row checkpoint, and make no live parameter, execution, configuration, trade, or retired-bot change.
**Next:** Settle markets `4038618` and `4038627`, continue collecting only qualifying post-boundary 15 UTC NO rows, and latch rejection at 10 rows if leave-best-out or SolSt1ne remains non-positive.

## 2026-09-01 17:30 UTC — [Pillar 1] Dominant-wallet concentration persists despite minimal net add

**Task:** Refresh the top-20 Hyperliquid cohort and test whether one hour of stabilization repairs the source breadth needed for a new BTC continuation anchor.
**Finding:** The tracker completed all 20 accounts. Gross shorts increased only $0.61M from $109.14M to $109.75M and net shorts deepened $0.63M to -$107.73M. Ecb6 added $0.55M to $19.83M and Bronny added $0.31M to $60.35M, while Auros cut $0.15M to $8.89M; 0x10f1 stayed unchanged at $9.91M and only about 9.03% of gross shorts. F5d8 cut its long by $0.23M to $0.49M, 0x3bca increased its long to $1.42M, and beatmaker flipped its small short into a $0.11M long. Raw shorts fell six to five while raw longs rose three to four.
